channel.title: The Melbourne Indian
channel.description: Independent, free-to-read news for Melbourne's Indian communities in English, Hindi and Punjabi.

item.title: Teenager arrested over online handle police say directed arson and a kidnapping in Melbourne
item.description: Operation Eclipse detectives arrested a 17-year-old boy in Fawkner on Friday after appealing for help to identify who was behind the 'Onepercent' username.

item.title: Bunnings to cut about 350 tech roles as Tata Consultancy Services takes over work from India and the Philippines
item.description: About 230 permanent jobs and 120 contractor roles will go from the hardware chain's Australian technology team, with the change complete by mid-2027.

item.title: Australia and China agree to hold talks on artificial intelligence as Albanese ends 11-day trip
item.description: The dialogue was agreed when Anthony Albanese met Premier Li Qiang in Beijing, days after Australia and India signed a US-led pact on AI supply chains.

item.title: A fifth Melbourne Cup is missing: Frank Reys's 1973 trophy was stolen from Flemington years ago, ABC reveals
item.description: The cup won by Gala Supreme, ridden by the first Indigenous jockey to win the race, was taken from a display at the racecourse and never recovered. A relative of Gala Supreme's trainer says security was 'lax'.

item.title: In India for the Victorian election? You can still vote in New Delhi, by post or by email
item.description: The Australian High Commission in New Delhi is taking votes on weekdays until 26 November. Postal vote applications close at 6pm Melbourne time on Wednesday.

item.title: Malaysia to end visa-free entry for Indian passport holders on 31 December
item.description: Indian nationals in Melbourne planning a Malaysian holiday or stopover in the new year may need to apply for a visa from 1 December.

item.title: Cyclone Akvan crosses the coast near Gopalpur, weaker than feared; no major damage reported
item.description: The storm came ashore between north Andhra Pradesh and southern Odisha on Friday morning, Indian time, as a cyclonic storm. Officials in both states say no major damage or deaths have been reported so far.

item.title: Eight days to go: where the Victorian election stands, and how to vote
item.description: More than 211,000 Victorians voted on the first full day of early voting. Here is what the polls say, what each party is pitching in the final week, and the dates you need.

item.title: Australia v England T20 at the MCG: start time, squads and getting there, with Delhi-born Nikhil Chaudhary in the home side
item.description: The five-match series starts at 7.15pm on Saturday. Gates open at 5.30pm, and there is no public parking at the ground.

item.title: 'It was the whole team': Bancroft breaks his silence on Sandpapergate, and Cummins stands firm
item.description: In a statement of more than 4,000 words, the batter banned over the 2018 Cape Town scandal says the fast bowlers, including Pat Cummins, talked with him about the ball. Cummins' manager says his position 'hasn't changed in eight years'.

item.title: One Nation would scrap parent visas and cut the refugee intake by 90 per cent, Hanson says
item.description: Pauline Hanson says people already in the queue would get their fees back, and parents already here would have to leave unless they find another way to stay. Penny Wong called the plan 'very harsh'.

item.title: Biggest pay rise in almost three years, but wages are still losing the race with prices
item.description: Wages rose 1.1 per cent in the September quarter, lifted by the minimum wage increase, ABS figures show. But prices are rising faster, and Victorian pay grew more slowly than in New South Wales.

item.title: Duckett century seals England's ODI series win in Hobart, with the T20s starting at the MCG on Saturday
item.description: England came back from a heavy loss in Perth to win the one-day series 2-1. The two teams now play five T20 internationals, starting in Melbourne at 7.15pm on Saturday.

item.title: Bandidos member can't explain $165,000 from union-aligned labour hire firm, Big Build inquiry hears
item.description: Ten days before Victoria votes, the royal commission into the CFMEU and the state's building projects has heard about bikies in safety jobs, a claimed 'direct line' to a minister's office and builders told to 'bend the knee'. Here is what it has heard, and where the major parties stand.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh readies evacuations for Cyclone Akvan, and tells fishermen to stay ashore until Friday
item.description: Disaster response teams are being deployed and pregnant women moved to hospitals ahead of Friday's expected landfall. Here are the helpline numbers to pass on to family.

item.title: Cyclone Akvan: orange alert for Andhra Pradesh and southern Odisha as the storm edges closer
item.description: The storm was about 620 km from Machilipatnam and Visakhapatnam early on Wednesday, Indian time. It is expected to cross the coast around midday on Friday, about 5.30pm in Melbourne.

item.title: Cyclone Akvan heads for the Andhra Pradesh coast, with landfall expected on Friday
item.description: India's weather office expects a very severe cyclonic storm to cross the coast around noon on 20 November, Indian time. That is about 5.30pm on Friday in Melbourne.

item.title: Quad leaders meet in Manila for the first time since Trump's return, with rare earths and AI on the table
item.description: Anthony Albanese, Narendra Modi, Sanae Takaichi and Donald Trump met on the sidelines of the ASEAN summit. In a joint statement, they took aim at economic coercion and announced a business forum and a first joint patrol-aircraft exercise for 2027.

item.title: Early voting starts today: where Labor, the Coalition, the Greens and One Nation stand on the big issues
item.description: Cost of living, housing, health, crime, transport and the budget: the main promises from the four parties whose leaders faced voters last night, side by side.

item.title: MS Dhoni's IPL career is over as Chennai Super Kings name him mentor for 2027
item.description: The 45-year-old, who captained Chennai to five IPL titles, did not play in 2026. He stays at the club as team mentor.

item.title: Carroll, Wilson, Sandell and Pickering face 100 undecided voters in the campaign's only leaders' forum
item.description: The night before early voting opens, the four leaders clashed over debt, schools and health in a 90-minute News24 and Herald Sun forum.

item.title: IDP Education, the IELTS co-owner and student placement firm, rejects a third Blackstone takeover bid
item.description: The board says A$3 a share undervalues the company, which has been hit by tighter student visa rules in Australia and other countries.

item.title: VicRoads closes its Dandenong centre: what to do now that services have moved to Pakenham
item.description: The new Pakenham centre, which VicRoads calls its largest, replaces the Dandenong centre. For many families in the south-east it means a longer trip, but much can be done online or at a post office.

item.title: Early voting opens on Wednesday: what you need to know before you go
item.description: You can vote early at more than 200 centres from Wednesday 18 to Friday 27 November, without giving a reason. Here are the hours, the help lines and what happens if you don't vote.

item.title: Waiting on a skilled visa? Here is the order Home Affairs processes them in
item.description: Since 19 September, priority sectors come first, then people who applied from inside Australia. Offshore applicants who included family members are at the back of the queue.

item.title: Quad leaders to meet in Manila as Trump arrives, with Modi and Albanese already there
item.description: The White House says President Trump will meet the leaders of Australia, India and Japan in Manila, the first Quad leaders' summit in two years. Reuters' sources point to Tuesday.

item.title: Parents visiting from India: new visitor visas will come with a 'no further stay' rule from 28 November
item.description: Visitor visas applied for from Saturday 28 November will stop most holders applying for another visa while they are in Australia. Applications lodged before then are not affected.

item.title: OCI cardholders: no late fee for updating new passport details until 31 December
item.description: India has waived the A$43 penalty for OCI cardholders who were late recording a new passport on the e-OCI portal, for applications made by the end of the year.

item.title: Coalition promises 'Celeste's Law': GPS tracking for high-risk stalkers if elected
item.description: The opposition says it would give all stalking victims the court protections family violence victims already have, and act on every recommendation of a 2022 law reform report.

item.title: Indian consulate's essay contest offers young Victorians a path to Pravasi Bharatiya Divas in Kolkata
item.description: Members of the Indian diaspora aged 21 to 25 in Victoria and Tasmania have until Friday 20 November to send in an essay.
